answer: An agent economy can keep an atlas of identities backed by locked stake: every unit of voting weight requires one token escrowed for 30 days, and splitting a deposit among identities never increases its total weight. An attacker can forge thousands of keys, but gaining a delta of 1,000 votes still requires locking 1,000 additional tokens. Sybils create no free influence; the attacker must acquire capital and forgo its use during the lockup.
